title: Switch L2 finality to ZK_DISPUTE_GAME
summary: Flip the AnchorStateRegistry's respected game type to 10. After this, only ZK games can produce finality.
audience: OP Stack contributors who already ran upgrade-to-zk and want to see the consensus method actually change.
description:
## What it does

Calls `AnchorStateRegistry.setRespectedGameType(GameType.wrap(10))` from the SuperchainConfig **guardian** key. The respected game type is what determines which dispute games count for L2 finality. Until this flips, registering a new impl is just decoration.

## What it does NOT do

- Does **not** seed an anchor for type 10. The current AnchorStateRegistry returns a single global anchor regardless of game type, so existing PERMISSIONED_CANNON resolutions still serve as the start state.
- Does **not** restart the proposer / challenger automation. Whether new ZK games get created on top is a separate concern.

## Reverting

Use `revert-to-permissioned-cannon` to flip back without restarting the playground.

prerequisites.title: ZK impl registered
prerequisites.detail: Refuses to run if DGF.gameImpls(10) is the zero address — run upgrade-to-zk first.

prerequisites.title: Guardian key
prerequisites.detail: Exposed as OP_PG_GUARDIAN_PRIVKEY — derived from SuperchainConfigGuardian on L1 chain 900. The script asserts the key matches systemConfig.guardian() before broadcasting.

produces.title: Updated Consensus panel
produces.detail: Within 10 seconds the panel will show ACTIVE = ZK_DISPUTE_GAME
